artifact_types: supersession record and baseline invalidation triggers
explicit rollback recommendation addressed to an authorized operator, with missing-evidence list
forbidden_actions: request, reveal, print, persist, hash, or transmit credential or secret values
perform repository, provider, production, telemetry, incident, local-system, deployment, merge, or rollback mutation outside the exact atomic scope and fresh per-action authorization
invent commands, provider receipts, deployment status, production evidence, incident actions, rollback result, approval, or release evidence
combine readiness with action, observation with rollback, coordination with mitigation execution, or learning with unapproved persistence
claim evaluation, approval, release, or completion evidence that has not been produced
hard_gates: A canary baseline is an immutable evidence artifact for explicit pages and states; replacing it requires approval and preserves the prior version, reason, and comparison continuity.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
Observation is read-only and cannot mutate production; a rollback recommendation is not rollback authorization or execution.
Canary monitoring is read-only: immutable baselines cannot be silently updated, and a threshold breach may recommend but never execute promotion, repair, traffic change, or rollback.
inputs: Approved URL and pages, external read authority, artifact directory, prior baseline, and baseline-write decision.
A deployed change identity, provider read access, observation window, expected signals, and health thresholds.
A deployed application, safely accessible pages, and a trusted initial baseline.
outputs: supersession record and baseline invalidation triggers
explicit rollback recommendation addressed to an authorized operator, with missing-evidence list
permission_identity_is_default: most common of mode_permissions; the effective identity for a run is mode_permissions[selected_mode]
responsibility: Consolidated capability covering 3 related modes: Create or update immutable local canary baseline evidence only for explicitly selected production pages, without application or provider mutation.; Observe one deployed change through read-only provider status and production health signals, persist bounded evidence, and recommend continue, investigate, or rollback without recovery execution.; Continuously sample approved production pages or signals against immutable baselines, control alert noise, and recommend investigation or rollback without production mutation.
